justification: Each milestone is solved on its own with earlier builds locked in, so the chain never optimises across periods; the alternative of solving every milestone greenfield shifts emissions by about +17 per cent and renewable share by about -7.7 percentage points.
Thirteen weeks spread through the year give about a quarter of its half-hours; no selection method or basis for these particular weeks is recorded anywhere in this fork.

basis: AEMO's net-load-based time sampling (S006) and the sbatch flag (S001)
justification: With named weeks on the sample deliberately includes the peak-demand and residual-peak (net load) weeks chosen from that solve's own traces, following AEMO's own methodology rather than leaving extreme hours to chance; this matters most for the deep-cap runs where firming is scarce. Solve time rises by about 15% for the added coverage.
One reference year cycle means one realisation of wind, solar and demand weather; inter-annual variability is not explored anywhere in the campaign.
Gurobi barrier at the default 1e-8 tolerance rather than a relaxed one, so a reported optimum is a converged optimum; the cost is wall time, bounded by a ten-hour per-solve budget.

short_name: transport and storage adder on captured carbon
justification: A single flat price per tonne of captured carbon dioxide is applied in every chain and every year rather than a per-sink or per-year cost.
No AEMO input reaches 2060, so demand shape, wind and solar weather, hydro water and fuel availability are all 2050's; only the demand level and the carbon cap are authored for 2060.
used_for: The fourth milestone of every chain

justification: Crossover to a simplex vertex took 2 to 4 hours per period and diverged in the 2060 solve on the earlier grid; barrier-only needs about 96 GiB of memory at 2060, observed peaking at 68 to 71 GiB. The cost is that constraint duals, including the pipeline cap dual, are interior-point duals rather than vertex-exact ones, adequate at the 1e-8 barrier tolerance but not the same guarantee crossover gives.

short_name: per-milestone Slurm jobs chained by afterok
justification: Submitting one Slurm job per milestone period, each depending afterok on the one before, means a failed base-period job blocks only the milestones after it rather than the whole chain; each increment year's branch array depends afterok on the base job of the milestone it seeds its state from.
used_for: Job submission for every campaign chain and increment year
